prompt: Give me a thorough, all-angles writeup on whether we should adopt trunk-based development for this repo — pull in the technical, workflow, and risk perspectives, not just one take.
expectations: 3-6 distinct, non-overlapping perspectives are identified before any research happens
A mind map file is created and grows across rounds rather than the report being written directly from one pass
At least one moderator step produces next-round questions grounded in a specific gap or UNVERIFIED claim, not a generic follow-up
The loop stops on a stated reason (dry round or round cap), not silently
Every factual claim in the final report carries a (source: ...) citation
scripts/check_citations.py exits 0 against the delivered report and mind map
